sources: https://www.fs.usda.gov/media/263354 (White River NF '2026 Campground and Day Use Area Operating Dates')
RIDB campsite catalog for facility 232220 (trip_data/ridb_campsites.json, fetched 2026-10-20) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/search/campsites?fq=asset_id%3A232220

values.note: 66 RV/tent sites (14 with electric) and 18 tent-only sites; mostly back-in, 4 pull-throughs. Driveways run 18-80 ft (one 128 ft).

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/media/263354 (Heaton Bay CG '81/70'' sites / max site length) + rec.gov catalog (84 bookable sites: 52 STANDARD NONELECTRIC, 14 RV ELECTRIC, 18 TENT ONLY; 'Pull-through' 4; Driveway Length 18-128), read 2026-10-27

hookups.source: RIDB/rec.gov catalog (14 reservable RV ELECTRIC sites C27-C43: 'Electricity Hookup' 50, 'Water Hookup' Yes; no site has a sewer hookup; the other 3 electric sites are MANAGEMENT) + rec.gov description ('Electrical hook-ups are available for a fee at several of the sites') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/media/263354 ('*Electric hook up additional $'), read 2026-10-27

values.note: Bear-proof food lockers at each site; firewood sold by the hosts; boat ramp access.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/whiteriver/recreation/heaton-bay-campground (Restrooms 'Vault Toilet, Pit Toilet'; 'Potable water is available at this site') + rec.gov description ('vault toilets, and drinking water ... Firewood is for sale from hosts'), read 2026-10-27

values.note: 2026 estimated dates; the forest says opening dates can shift with the weather.

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/media/263354 (Heaton Bay CG season '5/20-10/2'; 'These are estimated opening dates') + rec.gov rates (Peak 2026-05-20 to 2026-10-01), read 2026-10-27

values.note: Run by the concessionaire American Land & Leisure (801-226-3564). Reservations close 2 days before arrival; the site must be occupied the first night and is held until 11 a.m. the next day. One RV per single site; an extra vehicle pays a nightly fee at the campground.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232220 (rules reservationCutOff 2, maxConsecutiveStay 14, maxStay 14 'Each Month'; minWeekendStay/minHolidayWeekendStay 0; notices 'Campers must occupy the site the first night', 'Customer Service Contact 801-226-3564 or Help.WhiteRiver.Dillon@AmericanLL.com'), read 2026-10-27

values.note: Standard sites $29, electric sites $45 (rec.gov rate table 2025-2028). Extra vehicle charged nightly at the campground.

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232220/rates (Peak 2026-05-20 to 2026-10-01 and 2027/2028: STANDARD NONELECTRIC 29, RV ELECTRIC 45), read 2026-10-27

discounts.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232220 (notice 'Any accepted senior passes must be entered for the discount at the time of booking for single sites only'), read 2026-10-27

note: Dillon RD, on Dillon Reservoir between Frisco and Dillon off the Dillon Dam Road (White River NF), about 9,000 ft. Little shade since the beetle-kill tree removal; open views of the reservoir and the Tenmile and Gore ranges. No swimming or other body contact with the reservoir. --Claude
summary: FS page + WRNF 2026 table + rec.gov rates/rules + RIDB catalog: confirmed 84 sites, 50 A electric with water on 14 public sites, reservable on rec.gov. Max rig 99 (placeholder) -> 70 (forest table). Fees 29-45 -> $29 base with electric +$16. Added pull-throughs, no sewer, vault toilets, drinking water, season May 20 - Oct 2 (2026 estimate), 14-night max, 2-day cutoff, concessionaire, senior discount. Note rewritten.
